record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace uniform residual scaling 0.5 with block scales [0.65, 0.60, 0.55, 0.45, 0.40, 0.35]. Keeping their mean at 0.5 while emphasizing early contextual transformations and damping later updates may improve the six-block causal stack. Keep features, embeddings, dilation schedule, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed; synchronize predictor construction and checkpoint metadata.
